scripts.build: STRICT_ARMY=1 STRICT_FILM=1 node tools/check.mjs && node tools/build.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && rm -rf .deploy && mkdir .deploy && cp dist/*.html .deploy/index.html && cp public/* .deploy/ && if [ -d tiles ]; then cp -R tiles/ .deploy/tiles/; fi && npx -y wrangler@latest deploy
